profit.title: Real profit

reasons.CATALOG_NOT_FOUND: Item not found in the catalog. Update the catalog; the next import will try again.

reasons.DIRECTION_UNKNOWN: Could not tell whether it is a purchase or a sale.
reasons.TRADE_SENT_TO_OTHER_USER: The item was sent to someone else. Check on CSFloat.
reasons.PRICE_MISMATCH: The amount debited in the statement differs from the listing price.
reasons.REVERTED_PENDING_ACTION: CSFloat shows this trade was reversed. Check it and choose "Remove entry" or "Keep".
reasons.UNKNOWN_STATE: New CSFloat state ({state}). Skipped for safety.
reasons.PURCHASE_NOT_FOUND: Enter the purchase of this item by hand; the next import records the sale.
reasons.SALE_TX_NOT_FOUND: The CSFloat statement has not shown the credit for this sale yet. The next import will try again.
reasons.FEE_MISMATCH: CSFloat charged {fee}; by the store rules it would be {expected}. The real amount was recorded.
reasons.FEE_INCONSISTENT: The sale credit in the statement does not match the price minus the fee. Check on CSFloat; the next import will try again.
reasons.ITEM_TRADE_LOCKED: In the app, this item was still trade locked on the sale date. Check the item release date; the next import will try again.
reasons.REVERTED_STATE_FAILED: CSFloat marked this trade as failed or cancelled ({state}) after the import. Check it and choose "Remove entry" or "Keep".
reasons.REVERTED_OFFER_CHANGED: The Steam offer of this trade is no longer shown as accepted. It may have been reversed: check it and choose "Remove entry" or "Keep".
reasons.REVERTED_REFUND: The CSFloat statement shows a refund for this trade. Check it and choose "Remove entry" or "Keep".
reasons.WITHDRAWAL_FEE_ABOVE_AMOUNT: The fee of this withdrawal is larger than the amount withdrawn. Check on CSFloat.
reasons.WITHDRAWAL_FEE_MISMATCH: The fee charged on this withdrawal differs from the one suggested by the store withdrawal fees (just a warning).

fullScanConfirm.title: Full scan
fullScanConfirm.body: The app will read the whole CSFloat trade and statement history again, without stopping where the last import stopped. This uses more requests and can take up to 2 minutes. Nothing is duplicated: trades already imported are recognized by their ID, and your hand-made entries keep being linked by float (or by item, price and day). Trades before the cutoff date ({date}) stay out, so money already in your entries and deposits is not counted twice. To import older trades, change the cutoff date on the Imports page.

cutoffChange.title: Change cutoff date
cutoffChange.blockBody: Up to this date, you have already entered everything by hand or that period's balance is in a deposit. Trades before it are not imported.
cutoffChange.backwardHelp: Earlier date: imports the trades between the new date and the current one. New purchases deduct from the CSFloat store balance, and new sales credit it. If one of your deposits already included that period, money will be counted twice.
cutoffChange.forwardHelp: Later date: nothing already imported is deleted. Trades not imported yet before the new date stop being imported, and their pending items are closed.
cutoffChange.undoHelp: The change runs a full scan and can be undone with "Undo import" while it is the latest import that changed something.
cutoffChange.upToPurchases: Up to {count} purchase(s) already seen may come in ({value}). Some may be linked to your entries.
cutoffChange.upToSales: Up to {count} sale(s) already seen may come in ({value}).
cutoffChange.mayHaveUnseen: There are trades in this period the app has never read: the full scan will bring them too.
cutoffChange.manualLaunches: Your entries in the CSFloat store in this period: {purchases} purchase(s) and {sales} sale(s). They will be linked when they match, without duplicating.

depositsWarning.one: Warning: you have a deposit in the CSFloat store in this period. If it already included that period's balance, the imported purchases and sales will count the money twice.
depositsWarning.other: Warning: you have {count} deposits in the CSFloat store in this period. If they already included that period's balance, the imported purchases and sales will count the money twice.

cutoffChange.importedKept: {count} entry(ies) already imported in this period stay in the app.

cutoffChange.olderHint: Trades before the cutoff date are not imported.
cutoffChange.singleHint: There is a single cutoff date for everything from CSFloat: purchases, sales, deposits and withdrawals. Each import brings all of it together, from that date.

csfloatSetup.modalBody: Instead of typing, you can import your purchases, sales, deposits and withdrawals straight from CSFloat.
csfloatSetup.modalHint: To do that, connect CSFloat in Settings: the step-by-step guide is there and takes a minute.
csfloatSetup.title: How to connect CSFloat
csfloatSetup.step1: Sign in to CSFloat with your Steam account.
csfloatSetup.step2: Open your profile and go to the "Developers" tab.
csfloatSetup.step3: Click "New Key" and copy the key.
csfloatSetup.step4: Paste the key below, click "Save key" and then "Test connection".
csfloatSetup.step5: Click "Import now" (below) or "Import from CSFloat" in the Inventory and choose the cutoff date: up to when you already entered everything by hand.
csfloatSetup.safety: The key gives access to your CSFloat account: do not share it with anyone. If it leaks, delete it on CSFloat and create another one.
